Adult-child succession

Choose a living biological child who has reached adulthood from the death screen. No aging up minors or skipping time. Multiplayer transfers are server-verified and respect server respawn restrictions.
Relationship change multiplier
Scales both increases and decreases in companion affinity caused by player actions. 1 is normal, 2 doubles changes, and 0.5 halves them.
Game days per year of age
Default: one year of age per 365 game days. Adjustable from 1 to 3650 days. Rate changes apply prospectively without recalculating existing ages.
Age-related hair appearance
Grey from age 40, white from age 60. Expired dye returns to the natural color for the current age.
Player and NPC aging
Adults age from their saved age. Existing child growth schedules remain unchanged. No automatic death from old age.
Allow new pregnancies
Disabling prevents new NPC and player-NPC pregnancies. Existing pregnancies, births, childcare and growth continue.
Baby to child (game days)
Default 45, range 1-365. Saved when a baby is created. Existing growth schedules are preserved.
Baby care needs rate
Default 1, range 0-5. Scales increasing hunger, diaper dirt, tiredness and distress on the next update. Zero stops natural increases. Existing needs, sleep recovery, care effects and crying remain.
Child to adult (game days)

Default 320, range 1-1460. Applies to newly created babies and children. Total age at adulthood includes baby days. Requests may shorten childhood, to a minimum of one day. Existing schedules are preserved.
Close doors and windows after passage
Companions close doors and windows they opened after passing through. Disable to leave these passages open.
Companion dodge chance (%%)
Chance to avoid attack damage. 50 means 50%%, 0 disables dodging, and 95 is the maximum. Default: 50.
Down critically injured companions
Enabled: critically injured companions fall unconscious and await rescue. Disabled: this critical-injury downed behavior is not used.
Disable hostile bandit spawns
Blocks new hostile bandit waves and wandering groups. Friendly NPCs and already spawned bandits remain. Multiplayer uses the server setting.
Companion drinking thirst threshold
Default 35. Drinking starts at this thirst level. Thirst rises by 8 per game hour. Affinity no longer reduces hunger or thirst growth.
Protect companions from friendly weapon hits
Hair dye duration (game days)
Default 14 days. Applies to actual hair dye actions and NPC hair-color changes. Changes affect the next dye application.
Male balding chance at 40 (percent)
Default 20 percent. Determined once per character; reconnecting or changing this setting does not reroll an existing result.
Companion meal hunger threshold

Default 25. Normal meals start at this hunger level. Hunger rises by 3 per game hour: about 8 hours between foods that relieve 25 hunger. Item size and the needs rate setting affect actual meal frequency.
NPC right-click menu
Radial (default)
Classic list

Choose the menu shown when you right-click directly on an NPC. Radial opens on a short click and stays closed while holding to aim. Both styles include companion commands and quest actions from installed add-ons. Works without Shared Stories. Multiplayer uses the server setting.
Critical need threshold
Hunger, thirst and other needs rate
Controls worsening hunger, thirst, fatigue, boredom and hygiene over time. 1 is normal, 2 is double, 0.5 is half, and 0 stops time-based increases.
Player starting age
Only for players without an age record. Successors retain their own adult age.
Pregnancy duration (game days)
Default 300, range 3-730. Applies only to new pregnancies. Existing due dates are preserved.
Prevent companion gunfire vehicle-part damage
Companion skill XP multiplier
Scales skill XP gained from combat and work. 1 is normal and 2 doubles XP. Registered skill-book bonuses also apply.
Enable companion progression
Personality and trait snacking

Hotheaded/impulsive or food-loving companions may eat small carried foods while resting safely, regardless of hunger. At least 2 game hours after a meal, 6 between snacks, and at most 2 per rolling 24 hours. Real items and calories are consumed and recorded.
NPC arrival chance (%%)
Checks conditions hourly. Eligible attempts use this chance; reaching the configured guarantee triggers a spawn attempt regardless of chance. Zero disables natural spawning.
Friendly clan name or ID (empty: any friendly clan)
Spawn recruitable NPCs
Allows recruitable NPCs to appear in the world. Disabling this stops new automatic arrivals and keeps existing NPCs.
Spawn guarantee (eligible attempts)
Default 12. Counts eligible hourly attempts, not elapsed hours. A spawn attempt does not guarantee successful placement.
Nearby neutral survivor limit
Maximum unrecruited NPCs
Maximum living, naturally spawned NPCs awaiting recruitment in the world. Default: 12. Recruited companions do not count. A separate nearby limit prevents overcrowding.
